gameDescriptionHtml:
Unleash your creativity with staples of the hairdressing trade – see how much a simple haircut can change a person!

Experiment with colors and layering. Don’t forget about haircare – wash hair, shampoo using the best products, dry them and go through the whole hairstyling process step by step.

Balayage, perm or highlights – the creation choice is up to you!

Improve your styling skills and meet your customers expectations.

Straight, curly, or maybe you’d like bangs to complete a chic look? In Hairdresser, you have the opportunity to experiment with your own appearance – no scissors required! Upload a photo, and Hairdresser Simulator will transform it into a model ready for hair makeovers. Change your look or try out a new hairstyle, sandbox mode provides you with endless possibilities!

Aim for the top! Expand your empire and become a hairdressing mogul. Buy and renovate your salon, hire new employees, and learn a few tricks for your customers’ satisfaction. Stay up to date with current trends and purchase new products for the most discerning customer – the higher your rating, the more you earn. Don’t rest on your laurels and join the hair of fame.

With Hairdresser Simulator you’ll get various mechanics and features which will help you in your career.

Game Features

  • Prepare your salon, grab your scissors and get ready to cut!
  • Design your own character or upload a portrait photo – make them look like you or a favorite celebrity.
  • 9 salons to make your own – buy them up, improve them with your unique touch and rake in the money.
  • Renovate your salon, paint the walls and decorate as you please;
  • Treat your customers right with 10 distinct hairdressing actions: washing, shampooing, drying, brushing, cutting, dyeing and more. And that’s just what you can do before you start styling.
  • Take control of your customers’ hair with 11 hairdressing tools such as: scissors, razor, brush, hair straightener, curler, dryer, and more!
  • Manage your salon – from economics to the dirty floor. Somebody has to make sure there’s a decent profit margin… And make sure your workplace is clean and welcoming – and that person is you.
